children: The USDA has announced a new round of flash sales, with 182,800 metric tons of corn sold to Mexico for delivery in the 2026/27 marketing year. Additionally, 340,000 tons of soybeans were sold for delivery to China in 2026/27. An additional 100,000 tons of soybeans were sold to unknown destinations for delivery in 2026/27. The round of sales comes ahead of the USDA's WASDE Friday — with private firms forecasting that the USDA will likely lower its outlook for corn and soybean output. "Higher yields are achieved when there is a long and slow period for kernel filling, not a quick end to the growing season like we are seeing this year," says Michael Cordonnier of Soybean & Corn Advisor in a note. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
